explanation.headline: FDA's records show clopidogrel bisulfate is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include clopidogrel bisulfate as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 364 tablets of the 300 mg presentation with 26.2 days on hand at current use.
Corvale Lakeside holds 23 tablets of the same presentation with 8.9 days on hand at current use.
The top-ranked option is to transfer 14 tablets of 300 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside.
After the transfer Corvale General would retain about 25 days of supply and Corvale Lakeside would reach about 14 days.
Both sites' current stock carries the Apotex Corp. label with NDC 60505-3532-5.
